refunds.title: Refund & returns
refunds.updated: Last updated 4 September 2026 · Applies to orders placed on the {shop} website
refunds.short: sealed pouches can go back within 7 days. Opened food cannot — but if something arrived damaged, wrong, or off, tell us within 48 hours and we replace it, no return needed.
refunds.s1Body: Sealed, unopened pouches in their original condition can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Keep the batch code visible — it is printed on the back of the pouch and we need it to trace the lot.
refunds.s2Body: Ground spices are a consumable food product. Once a pouch has been opened we cannot accept it back, and we cannot resell it. This is a food-safety limit, not a commercial one. If an opened pack is genuinely defective — wrong product, contamination, off aroma — section 5 covers it instead.
refunds.s3Body: Email {email} or call {phone} between 10 am and 6 pm, Monday to Saturday, with your order number and the batch code. We will confirm within one working day and arrange a pickup where the pincode is serviceable.
refunds.s4Body: Once the returned pouch reaches Habsiguda and passes inspection, the refund is initiated within 2 working days. Prepaid orders land back on the original payment method in 5–7 working days, depending on your bank.
refunds.s5Body: Send a photograph of the outer carton, the pouch and the batch code within 48 hours of delivery. We replace or refund in full, including the shipping charge, and you do not need to return the item.
refunds.s6Body: You can cancel an order until it is packed, usually the morning after you place it. Call or email us with the order number. Once an order has been handed to the courier it can no longer be cancelled, but sealed pouches can still be returned under section 1.
refunds.s7Body: Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer or UPI to an account you name. We will ask for the account details by email and never by phone call or message. The cash-on-delivery handling fee is refunded only when the return is because of our error.
refunds.s8Body:
Consumer care: {email}, {phone}, Monday to Saturday, 10 am – 6 pm IST.
Please keep your order number and batch code ready; it lets us answer in one go.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Last updated 4 September 2026 · Applies to the {shop} website and its orders
privacy.short: we collect what we need to deliver your order and send your invoice, keep it safe, and never sell it.
privacy.s1Body: Your name, mobile number, email and delivery address when you order; your order history if you create an account; and basic, anonymous usage data about how the site is used.
privacy.s2Body: To process and deliver orders, send invoices and order updates, answer your questions, and keep the site secure. We send offers only if you have agreed to receive them.
privacy.s3Body: Only with the partners who make an order happen — our payment processor, our couriers and our e-commerce platform — and only what each of them needs. We do not sell your data.
privacy.s4Body: Payments are handled by our payment processor on its own secure pages. We never see or store your full card or bank details.
privacy.s5Body: We use the cookies the site needs to work, and others only with your consent. You can change your choice at any time from Cookie settings at the foot of every page.
privacy.s6Body: You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal data we hold about you. Write to {email} and we will reply within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.updated: Last updated 4 September 2026 · Applies to every order placed on the {shop} website
terms.short: prices include GST, an order is confirmed once it is paid or accepted for cash on delivery, and our refund policy covers what happens if something goes wrong.
terms.s1Body: This website is run by Bigsof Current Pvt Ltd, which packs and sells the products listed on it. By placing an order you agree to these terms.
terms.s2Body: Product photos show the pack; colours may vary slightly between screens. Prices are in Indian rupees and include GST. We may change prices at any time, but never on an order already confirmed.
terms.s3Body: An order is confirmed when payment succeeds, or when a cash-on-delivery order is accepted. We may cancel an order if a product becomes unavailable or a delivery address is not serviceable, and will refund any payment in full.
terms.s4Body: Delivery times and charges are set out in our Shipping policy and shown at checkout before you pay.
terms.s5Body: Returns, replacements and refunds follow our Refund & returns policy.
terms.s6Body: Our products are food. Please read the label, including the allergen advice, before use. Our liability for any order is limited to the amount paid for it, except where the law does not allow such a limit.
terms.s7Body: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Please contact us first at {email} so we can try to resolve any concern directly.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.updated: Last updated 4 September 2026 · Applies to deliveries within India
shipping.short: every order ships from {city} within 48 hours, with tracking, and the delivery charge for your basket is shown at checkout before you pay.
shipping.s1Body: We deliver to serviceable pincodes across India. Enter your pincode at checkout to see whether we reach it and what delivery costs.
shipping.s2Body: Orders are packed and handed to the courier within 48 hours, Monday to Saturday. Orders placed on Sundays and public holidays ship the next working day.
shipping.s3Body: Most metro cities receive orders two to four working days after dispatch; other locations can take up to seven working days.
shipping.s4Body: Delivery is free above the order value shown at checkout. Below it, the delivery charge is shown at checkout before you pay.
shipping.s5Body: Cash on delivery is available on most pincodes. It carries a small handling fee and an order limit, both shown at checkout.
shipping.s6Body: You receive a tracking link once your order is handed to the courier. If a delivery is missed, the courier tries again; after repeated failed attempts the parcel returns to us and we will contact you.

fssai.title: FSSAI & labelling
fssai.updated: Last updated 4 September 2026 · What every pack carries, and why
fssai.short: every pack carries its FSSAI licence number, net quantity, MRP, batch code, packing date and best-before, as the law requires.
fssai.s1Body: Our products are packed under FSSAI licence [your FSSAI licence number], issued to Bigsof Current Pvt Ltd. The number is printed on every pack.
fssai.s2Body: Product name, ingredients in descending order, net quantity, MRP inclusive of all taxes, batch code, date of packing, best-before, allergen advice, the manufacturer's name and address, and the consumer care contact.
fssai.s3Body: Net quantity is declared under the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules. The MRP on the pack is the most you will ever pay; the website price is never higher.
fssai.s4Body: The batch code links each pouch to its raw-material lot and production run. Please quote it with any question or complaint so we can trace it.
fssai.s5Body: Our products are packed in a facility that also handles mustard and sesame. Blends list every ingredient on the label.
fssai.s6Body: If a pack looks, smells or tastes wrong, stop using it and contact us at {email} or {phone} with the batch code. You can also raise a concern with FSSAI through its consumer grievance portal.
